intended_object: For an action G on P, sets s ⊆ G, t ⊆ P and a point a ∈ P, the set {(g, p) ∈ s × t | g • p = a} of pairs from s and t whose scalar product is a. This is the scalar-multiplication analogue of the multiplication antidiagonal (from the docstring and the name).
explanation: The body {x | x.1 ∈ s ∧ x.2 ∈ t ∧ x.1 • x.2 = a} is exactly the intended set. It assumes only [SMul G P], the minimal setting in which g • p is defined, so the generality is natural. Set.mulAntidiagonal is the special case of a type acting on itself by multiplication. The additive version generated by to_additive is also correct. Degenerate cases (empty s or t) give the empty set, as they should.
